verdict.rationale: Typesense claims native LLM integrations with built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Natural Language Search. Its docs index lists RAG alongside vector and hybrid search, and it ships a conversational search demo, so retrieval and answer generation on top of indexes is supported. The evidence, however, is mostly comparison-page and index-level claims rather than detailed API documentation. Missing for 10: a detailed reference for the conversational/RAG answer endpoint (parameters, conversation history, model configuration) and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG quality.
